data.summary: Optik Beispielblick sent a reminder that €263.00 of the €563.00 total price for the progressive lenses glasses you picked up on 6 November 2026 is still unpaid (you had already paid a €300.00 deposit). They ask for payment by 15 December 2026 or in person at your next visit.
data.explanation: This is a friendly payment reminder from your optician, not a formal demand with late fees. Transfer the remaining €263.00 to the given account by the stated date, or simply pay in the shop next time you visit. The letter does not mention any consequence for paying late, but it is best to settle it on time to avoid a formal dunning later. No legal or tax advice is needed here.
